title: Name Input and Output
prompt:
Write a program that asks the user for their name and then prints out a greeting message with the name.
Sample Input: John
Sample Output: Hello, John!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a simple Python program that meets your requirements:
```python
# Ask the user for their name
name = input("Please enter your name: ")

# Print a greeting message with the name
greeting = f"Hello, {name}!"
print(greeting)
```
When you run this program and enter your name as the sample input "John", the output will be:
```
Please enter your name: John
Hello, John!
```
I hope this helps! Let me know if you have any other questions.
